crude_oil.india_position: Net importer — imports ~85–88% of crude needs; oil is India's single largest import item (~a quarter of the import bill). ~40% historically sourced from the Middle East/Gulf, with Russia now a leading supplier.
crude_oil.price_rise_effect: Negative for the economy: every ~$10/bbl rise widens the current-account deficit, pressures the rupee, and fuels input-cost inflation.
crude_oil.notes: Discounted Russian crude has cushioned India; a supply shock still raises the landed price.

textiles.india_position: India is a major textile and apparel exporter; competes directly with Bangladesh, Vietnam and China for global garment orders.
textiles.disruption_effect: Disruption at a rival hub (e.g. Bangladesh) or a China+1 shift redirects export orders to Indian garment and home-textile makers.

natural_gas.india_position: Growing LNG importer; sensitive to spot LNG prices.
natural_gas.price_rise_effect: Negative: raises fertilizer, power, city-gas and CGD input costs.

lng.india_position: Rising LNG importer (US, Qatar, UAE, Australia).
lng.price_rise_effect: Negative: raises gas-based fertilizer, power and city-gas costs.

wheat.price_rise_effect: Global shortage can open export windows for Indian wheat, but govt may curb exports to control domestic food inflation.

sunflower_oil.india_position: Major importer of edible oils; large sunflower-oil buyer from Russia/Ukraine region.
sunflower_oil.price_rise_effect: Negative: raises edible-oil costs, hits FMCG margins and food inflation.

palm_oil.india_position: India imports ~55–60% of its edible oil; palm oil is the largest share, sourced mainly from Indonesia and Malaysia.
palm_oil.price_rise_effect: Negative: raises edible-oil and FMCG input costs; export bans by producers (as Indonesia has imposed) are an acute shock.

fertilizers.india_position: Large importer of fertilizers and inputs (potash, phosphates, gas for urea).
fertilizers.price_rise_effect: Negative: raises subsidy burden and farm input costs; hits fertilizer makers' margins if uncompensated.

potash.price_rise_effect: Negative: raises fertilizer costs and subsidy burden.

defense.india_position: Historically a top arms importer; policy push to indigenize and grow exports.
defense.supply_disruption_effect: Supply strain from a supplier (e.g. Russia) accelerates the domestic defense-manufacturing theme.

semiconductors.india_position: Near-total import dependence; nascent domestic fab ambitions.
semiconductors.supply_disruption_effect: A Taiwan/Korea disruption would hit electronics/auto/appliance production and prices globally.

electronics.india_position: Heavy import reliance on China; PLI-backed onshoring under way.
electronics.supply_disruption_effect: Disruption raises component costs but accelerates domestic electronics manufacturing.

rare_earths.india_position: Dependent on China for rare-earth magnets used in EVs, electronics and defense.
rare_earths.supply_disruption_effect: A Chinese export curb squeezes EV/electronics/defense supply chains globally.

pharmaceuticals_api.india_position: Depends on China for roughly 60–70% of its bulk-drug / active pharma ingredient (API) needs, despite being the world's largest generics exporter.
pharmaceuticals_api.supply_disruption_effect: A China supply cut raises API costs and boosts domestic API-manufacturing (PLI-backed) incentives.

thermal_coal.india_position: Imports a meaningful share of thermal/coking coal (Indonesia, Australia, Russia) despite large domestic output.
thermal_coal.price_rise_effect: Negative for power and cement input costs; positive for domestic coal producers.

gold.india_position: One of the world's largest gold importers; safe-haven demand rises in crises.
gold.price_rise_effect: Widens trade deficit, but lifts jewellery/gold-financier revenues and hedging demand.

shipping.india_position: Trade-route sensitive (Hormuz for crude, Red Sea/Suez for exports to Europe).
shipping.disruption_effect: Higher freight and insurance costs; longer transit; margin pressure for exporters and importers; gains for shipping owners.
